learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish current tax from deferred tax
Account for current tax assets and liabilities for the period
Explain the temporary-difference approach to deferred tax
Identify common taxable and deductible temporary differences
Measure deferred tax using appropriate rates and recognise deferred tax assets
Present and disclose income taxes, including the tax reconciliation

integrative_case: A company has accelerated tax allowances on its plant, carried-forward tax losses, and a revaluation taken to other comprehensive income; compute the current tax charge, identify the temporary differences and their tax bases, assess recoverability of the loss-related deferred tax asset, measure the balances at the correct rate, and prepare the tax reconciliation disclosure.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
